item.title: Incarico post-doc: Development of DNA-programmed synthetic biomimetic systems (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The project aims to develop and characterize biomimetic systems based on lipid vesicles functionalized with nucleic acids. The vesicles, consisting of liposomes, will be specifically engineered to acquire fusogenic properties that can be modulated through the chemical composition of the lipid component and the presence of integrated DNA
